card.name: Words before a drug class name
card.fires_on: Linking words such as "other" or "to" right before a drug class or protein name, especially in lines like "patients treated with other anti-CD20 antibodies". It also fires on a few spots inside drug names.

modes.label: "other" before a drug class
modes.description: The word "other" after "treated with" or "and", introducing a class of similar drugs.
modes.example: JCV infection resulting in PML has also been observed in patients treated with<< other>> anti-CD20 antibodies and other

modes.label: Partway through a drug name
modes.description: A piece inside a drug name or the bracket after it, before the rest of the name or a group label.

card.writes: It seems to push the next word toward a noun naming a molecule or substance, and away from words like "mass".
card.plain: It lights up on small words just before the text names a drug class or substance.
